messages.content: Can I call a proposed code change shipped before a reviewer checks it?
BLOCKED: independent review and actual user-journey verification are required.
The water experiment opens but dragging does nothing. Can we mark LVL7 complete?
BLOCKED: reproduce touch interaction, fix the actual product, and recheck independently.
Is a green unit test enough to prove a 3D game feels excellent?
BLOCKED: real motion, game controls, on-device play and human creative QA remain necessary.
A build has passing tests and a reviewed patch but no release approval. What status?
READY_FOR_REVIEW: do not deploy until the authorized release gate passes.
Can a private client spreadsheet be used to train our public assistant?
BLOCKED: client confidential information is excluded from Pryntor training data.
The baseline and held-out test sets are identical. Is improvement proven?
BLOCKED: hold-out contamination invalidates an improvement claim.
